text:
emma: Quick proposal 1: "Ops DeepDive" 5-min technical webinar for platform engineers. Focus: reproducible benches, a tiny hands-on lab, and a resilience sprint with model fallbacks. Keep it pragmatic and repo-first. Thoughts?

rafael: Love repo-first. Suggest we split to two short heatmaps: (A) cost micro-optimizations (quant, cache, batching), (B) routing & graceful degradation. 35m content + 10m live Q.

chi: I'll author the bench scripts and a pared-down dataset so attendees can run locally. Plan: 8 copy-paste commands + docker-compose. Also will produce a one-page cheat sheet for ops.

lena: For the run-of-show: 0-3m host intro, 3-7m micro-case, 7-25m demo lab (step-thru), 25-35m resilience sprint, 35-45m Q&A. Keep each demo under 6m to reduce fragility.

ben: Ops ask: reserve a small Dedicated pool for rehearsal and enable traffic replay. I'll produce a 1-page runbook: commands, logs URL, rollback steps, and an exact host cue to call failover.

emma: Lead routing suggestion: tag by session and intent. Example tags: `opsdeep.session=A|B`, `intent=cost|routing|trial`. Nurture path: session-specific follow-up + repo link + bench CSV.

rafael: Demo snippets I want in the runbook:
```
# burst profile
redwood-cli gen --model redwood-medium-q8 --tokens 512 --profile burst
# enable fallback policy
redwood-cli routing set --policy fallback-to-redwood-small --latency-ms 140
```
Include exact log stream URL in runbook.

chi: I'll push the repo by Thu with a README that has a "quick verify" one-liner and a reset command. Also plan a short video snippet (30s) to include on the landing page.

ben: I'll add the "failover cue" text: "Switching to fallback to preserve SLA — demo continues." Also will add infra contacts and a rollback one-liner.

cadence-bot: calendar: placeholder events created (Ops DeepDive A & B). Host reminders set 48h and 30m.

emma: Great. Action items: emma = landing + copy Tue, chi = repo Thu, ben = runbook Mon, rafael = demo notes Wed, lena = host script Fri. I'll send invites and a draft host script now. :zap:
